# Amir Raza — Shopify Expert & Performance Marketer

> Amir Raza is a Shopify development and performance marketing specialist based in Karachi, Pakistan, working with ecommerce brands in Pakistan and internationally. Services: Shopify store development, Meta & Google Ads management, Daraz store management, brand/creative design, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).

Verified performance (from Meta Ads Manager account data, 14 Aug–11 Nov 2026): PKR 7.12M in managed ad spend, 8,410 website purchases, 4.90X average Purchase ROAS and 8.53X highest verified Purchase ROAS (best campaign using at least 5% of its account's spend), across five verified ecommerce accounts. Experience spans 30 ecommerce stores in 10+ industries.
